annotations.title: Accept a quote and pay: re-test or expedited first review (x402)

description: Accept a quote and pay the quoted total via x402 (USDC on Base) — paid automatically by your x402 MCP client. Two quotes settle here: (a) a re-test of an already-reviewed service (from request_retest) — input the exact service_name and quote_total_usd; (b) a paid expedited first review (from request_review with include_testing_expedite_listing) — input service_name, service_url, and quote_total_usd; on settlement the service is added to the directory as UNTESTED and queued for a full first review in the next nightly pass. Optionally pass email_for_notification — an email address we notify when the test verdict is delivered. On settlement the request is recorded (status paid, tx stored) and queued.

email_for_notification.description: Optional email address to notify when the test verdict is delivered. Stored with the paid request only; never required to pay.

quote_total_usd.description: Total from the request_retest (or request_review expedite) quote you are accepting

reason.description: Why a re-test is needed (stored with the request)

service_name.description: Exact service name, as listed by search_services (free)

service_url.description: Required only for a paid expedited first review (the service_url from the request_review expedite quote). Omit for re-tests.
